capabilities: Prioritize tasks across four Eisenhower quadrants
Drag tasks between quadrants on desktop and mobile
Complete, revive or delete tasks with undo
Edit task titles and due dates inline
Show relative due dates with overdue highlighting
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual way to sort and prioritize tasks by urgency and importance.
summary: Visual Eisenhower matrix that prioritizes tasks in Do, Schedule, Delegate and Eliminate quadrants, with drag-and-drop, due dates and completion tracking.
